Adding a few practical notes from Marketplace Ops: 

- Branding: AWS/Azure require non-overlapping logos and specific padding. They also forbid implying endorsement ("Built with Redwood Inference, an AWS Verified Service").
- Claims: "Enterprise-grade" is a marketing phrase; if you have customer references or an SLA to back it we can keep something similar, but avoid hard uptime percentages unless you can point to contractual SLAs. Recommend something like: "Designed for production reliability; contact us for SLA details."
- Support: Co-sell customers will expect a clear support path. Marketplace copies should not promise a custom 24/7 white-glove unless Redwoods' Dedicated offering is contracted. For co-sell listing text, recommended phrasing: "Business hours support with on-call escalation; enterprise SLA available through purchase."
- Assets: Image specs attached (PNG 1024x512, transparent bg preferred).

I'll redline the attached PDF and upload a marked-up copy after our call. Also sending our internal marketplace policy link: https://docs.redwood/marketplace/policy-guidelines

Laura Bennett
Marketplace Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick compliance points from security/privacy: 

- SOC 2: Marketplace listings need a statement of compliance and link to an attestation. Beth: can you attach the SOC 2 report or a stub we can link to?
- Data handling: must include a brief note about telemetry and logs (what is collected, retention, and how it's used). Avoid vague statements like "we may collect usage data"; prefer precise language e.g., "We collect request metadata for 30 days to support debugging; no customer prompt content is stored longer than 7 days unless configured by the customer."
- Residency: If BigCorp expects EU-only data, the listing must explicitly state region restrictions. If not, default to standard multi-region with options for VPC/private deployments.

I attached a short redline for the support SLA copy and a template sentence for telemetry. Also, we will need an attestation file (SOC2_Attestation_stub.pdf is fine initially) and confirmation of whether BigCorp will surface a privacy contact email on the listing.

Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance
